one_line: No-code GTM data enrichment and automation platform (with Claygent AI) for finding and enriching contacts.
auth_notes: Clay has a limited REST API for exporting/triggering runs; primary model is no-code tables rather than OAuth API access
self_serve_notes: Self-serve signup with free plan and trial credits; paid plans based on credits; API access available but is not the primary interface

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Limited public API (triggers, exports); most functionality is internal/no-code; docs at docs.clay.com
api_surface.webhook_note: Workflow triggers and exports to external tools supported; no broad event webhook API confirmed

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server confirmed; some community servers exist (knowledge)

evidence.note: fetched text is Clay University (learning) page confirming no-code platform and Claygent; API facts from knowledge
